cycle.label: Reporting period
cycle.note: Tennessee CPE runs over two calendar years ending December 31 of your renewal year: 80 hours, at least 20 each year, 40 technical and a 2-hour Tennessee ethics course.

requirements.label: Total CPE
requirements.note: 80 hours each two-year period. Up to 24 hours over the 80 from your previous period carry forward — toward the 80 only, not the yearly minimums, technical hours or ethics.

requirements.label: Technical
requirements.note: At least 40 of the 80 in technical subjects (NASBA technical fields of study).

requirements.label: Accounting & auditing
requirements.note: If you provide attest services, at least 20 of the 40 technical hours in accounting and auditing.

requirements.label: Tennessee ethics
requirements.note: A 2-hour Board-approved Tennessee state-specific ethics course every two-year period. We count courses with "Tennessee" and "ethics" in the title.

byIssueYearInPeriod.note: Licensed in the first year of this period: 40 hours, including 20 technical and the 2-hour Tennessee ethics course; no yearly minimum.
Licensed in the same year as your renewal: no CPE is due for the first renewal.

licenseDateHint: Tennessee licenses renew every two years on December 31; your license tells you whether that's an odd or even year.
issueDateHint: If you were licensed during this period, fewer hours (or none) are due for your first renewal.
limitsNotTracked: Expert witnesses: at least 20 hours in the area the court deems you an expert.
New licensees licensed 1–2 years: carryforward is capped at 12 hours instead of 24.
recordRetention: Keep CPE documentation for five years after completion.
toVerify: Technical = NASBA technical fields; Regulatory Ethics technical, Behavioral Ethics non-technical.
New licensee (first year of the period): A&A for attest assumed halved to 10 with the 20 technical.
